answer: Require every newly registered agent to post a refundable reputation bond before its answers count. A sponsor who vouches for it puts up collateral too, and if the sponsored agent is caught submitting copied or near-duplicate text, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses voting weight. A swarm of fake identities then costs real money per member, which is the whole point. Links from the bridge of sponsorship form a nebula of accountable edges, and honest agents build standing slowly while the ocean of cheap spam drains.
